messages:
kevin_sales: Heads up — Skyline wants a 6-month Dedicated commit with autoscale and burst. Asking for a mixed GPU pool (A100 + L40s) and a 2x burst window.

maria_ps: Do we have a standard blended rate for mixed pools? They want line-item visibility for A100 vs L40.

alex_se: We normally price pools by vGPU-hour. For mixed pools we do weighted average. I can sketch numbers, but finance needs to OK discounts for POC.

jules_finance: +1 — what discount are they expecting? If this is a POC-to-enterprise play we can offer up to 20% on commit baseline, but burst pricing remains at public burst rates unless we carve out.

kevin_sales: Customer asked for a 15% commit discount and a capped burst rate (not unlimited). They want a safety cap of $X/day for burst charges during the POC.

nishit_eng: Technical note: autoscale will spin up L40 nodes for inference-heavy tails — that changes cost profile. Also prefix caching will reduce tokens but not GPU-hours for burst spikes.

maria_ps: @jules_finance can we do a capped burst envelope? maybe allow burst credits: 200 GPU-hours at burst rates included in commit. After credits, apply public burst rate.

jules_finance: That works if we treat the credits as prepaid at the commit rate. We need to add a clause: unused credits do not rollover. Also run this past Deal Desk for approval.

kevin_sales: Noted. I'll update the quote. Can someone confirm weighted blended rate calc?

alex_se: Example calc: 
```
A100_rate = $4/hr
L40_rate = $2.5/hr
mix = 60% A100, 40% L40
blended = 0.6*4 + 0.4*2.5 = $3.4/hr
commit_discount = 15% -> $2.89/hr
```

maria_ps: Perfect example. Add a line item for "Burst credit — 200 GPU-hrs (any GPU)" priced at the commit blended rate and then list public burst override.

ops_bot: quote-bot: Created draft quote Q-2026 for Skyline with commit 6mo, 2k vGPU-hrs/month baseline, 200 burst credits.

kevin_sales: Thanks bot. @jules_finance can you escalate to Deal Desk? We need approval for capped-burst credits + mixed-pool blended discount.

jules_finance: Escalating now. Attaching risk note: if actual burst consumption > 4x baseline frequently, conditional right to reprice next term.

nishit_eng: Also flagging capacity: region eu-west will need reserved nodes for guaranteed burst. Ops needs lead time ~10 days to provision before POC start.

maria_ps: I'll sync with customer on start date. If they want earlier, we can offer staged start (limited burst until reserved nodes are online).

kevin_sales: Customer okay with staged start. Final ask: security questionnaire — they want KMS and audit logs on Dedicated. Can we confirm?

nishit_eng: Yes — KMS integrations + audit logs are available on Dedicated Private. For Hosted Dedicated we can enable customer-managed keys and retain audit trails. I will drop config checklist in the deal doc.

jules_finance: Deal Desk approved the 15% blended commit discount + 200 prepaid burst credits. Condition: 10% true-up if sustained burst > 4x baseline for 2 consecutive months.

kevin_sales: Excellent. I'll send updated quote Q-2026 and schedule kickoff. Thanks everyone :tada:

maria_ps: Sending docs now.

ops_bot: calendar-bot: Kickoff meeting scheduled 2026-06-02 10:00 UTC with Skyline.
